pages.contents: One landscape CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report. A red-headed table lists reporting topics and items 1 to 13 (title, key words, abstract, introduction, patient information, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment, therapeutic intervention, follow-up and outcomes, discussion, patient perspective, informed consent) with a "Reported on Line" column filled with manuscript line ranges for items 1 to 12. In the informed-consent row the Yes box contains an X and the No box is empty. The page header carries the CARE logo, a Creative Commons BY-NC-ND badge and a check mark.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Administrative reporting checklist with manuscript line references and a consent checkbox; it contains no history, test results, doses, treatment course or outcomes. No clinical-schema facts are generated from it.
